summary: guardrails-detectors is a Kubernetes component. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports: 8000, 8080. runtime dependencies: MinIO/S3. Python k8s client with 6 API call(s). integrates with Istio via labels/annotations.
repository_description: FMS Guardrails Orchestrator is an open source project led by IBM which provides a server for invocation of detectors on text generation input and output, and standalone detections.
